title: WGomez Rice Sacks
client: WGomez Vegetables & Grain Trading · Nueva Ecija
summary: A 25 kg rice sack series and trading logo for a Nueva Ecija rice wholesaler.

caseStudy.brief: WGomez Vegetables & Grain Trading, a rice wholesaler in Nueva Ecija, needed a trading logo and sacks for four rice brands: Ivy’s, Sofia’s, Wave Nher’s and Wency’s.
caseStudy.did: As Packaging Designer I designed the WGomez trading seal and the full family of 25 kg rice sacks.
decisions: Each sack uses a single bold colour field, so the varieties are easy to tell apart in a warehouse stack.
A shared front layout and an “Export Quality” back panel keep the four brands recognisable as one supplier.
